name: manati wafer
ingredients_raw: Cream (60%) (Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Olein), Maltodextrin, Whey Powder, Non Dairy Creamer (Glucose Syrup, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil, Sodium Caseinate and Milk Powder, Modified Starch (INS 1440), Stabilizers (INS 340(ii), INS 331(iii)), Emulsifier (INS 471, INS 481(i)), Anti Caking Agent (INS 551), Flavour), Edible Common Salt, Emulsifier (INS 322), Synthetic Flavour). Wafer Sheet (40%) (Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Olein), Edible Common Salt, Leavening Agent (INS 500(ii)), Emulsifier (INS 322), Premixes (Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Improver (INS 1101(i))), Permitted Food Colour (INS 127)). Contains added flavour (synthetic rose milk flavour) and permitted synthetic food colour
